chunks: ʿAlī, from Abū ʿAlī Aḥmad ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Idrīs, from his father, that he said:
I saw him, peace be upon him, after the passing of Abū Muḥammad, when he had reached adolescence, and I kissed his hands and his head.

key_terms.أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ: Abū Muḥammad; the father whose death is being referenced
key_terms.أَيْفَعَ: having reached adolescence or youthful maturity
key_terms.رَأَيْتُهُ: I saw him; a direct personal observation
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: Who reported seeing the Imam عليه السلام after the passing of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report records a firsthand sighting of the Imam عليه السلام after the passing of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام. It serves as a biographical testimony connected to the recognition and identification of the Imam in the early period after his father's death.
